question: How does a company apply for permission to put up a mobile tower or lay optical fibre in Maharashtra?
gold_answer: Fresh applications go through the GatiShakti Sanchar portal (gatishaktisanchar.gov.in), per the telecom infrastructure policy GR of 04-11-2022 (forest department applications excepted; regularisation of existing infrastructure through the Mahasanchar portal). Earlier, the 03-03-2018 circular had applications filed in hard copy with local authorities until the DGIT single-window portal was ready
model_answer: The 2018 GR (03-03-2018) states that until the online single-window portal is activated, applicants must submit hard-copy applications to the concerned local authorities for telecom towers, micro cells, masts, base stations, and optical fibre cable, and these must be processed according to the policy dated 17.02.2018. A copy should also be sent by email to mahatip@maharashtra.gov.in. I couldn't find a GR on this in the corpus.
